title: Monster Farm - one in-game day v1 (before)

findings.message: No beat reaches 6/10 in the first 10% of the experience (best is 4). Players decide early whether to keep going.
findings.suggestion: Open with a short, legible high-interest moment (a promise of the core fantasy, a striking reveal, or a quick win), then dip to teach.

findings.message: 0.0-3.5: intensity stays within ±0.5 around 3.9 for 3.5 units (low and flat: boredom and quit risk).
findings.suggestion: Insert a contrast beat: a twist on the current mechanic, a new threat, a reveal, a reward, or a deliberate rest that sets up the next rise.

findings.message: The strongest moment (8, Rare crop harvest + shipping payout) happens at 33% of the experience; later beats never top it.
findings.suggestion: Move or build a climax into the last 30%, or reduce the early peak so the ending is the highest point.

findings.message: 5.8-14.0: intensity stays within ±0.5 around 3.6 for 8.2 units (low and flat: boredom and quit risk).
findings.suggestion: Insert a contrast beat: a twist on the current mechanic, a new threat, a reveal, a reward, or a deliberate rest that sets up the next rise.
